verdict.rationale: Vercel documents its own CDN caching files close to users (Blob), serving on-demand optimized images from the CDN, and metered CDN requests and data transfer in pricing, so CDN-backed edge delivery of static assets is a first-party capability. missing for 10: a dedicated CDN or edge-cache doc covering static deployment assets, cache-control and invalidation details, an explicit global PoP footprint, and independent or hands-on performance corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve static assets faster using a global CDN with edge caching

citations.quote: Vercel's CDN caches your files close to your users.
Resize and convert images on demand and serve them from the CDN in modern formats.
